title: Canonical mixed SCP: FullAWSAccess Allow ceiling + region Deny guardrail
note: IAM-1302 iteration-3 regression: the most common real-world SCP shape carries the AWS managed FullAWSAccess Allow (Action */Resource *) alongside a region Deny guardrail. Under an EXPLICIT SCP selection it is analyzed as a CEILING/GUARDRAIL: the FullAWSAccess statement is a maximum-permissions ENVELOPE (SCP-CEILING, never a grant) and the negated-IfExists aws:RequestedRegion Deny is a region GUARDRAIL (SCP-GUARDRAIL, over-broad-regional-Deny hazard). ZERO capability edges, no escalation, ceiling-not-grant framing on every finding. Under AUTO-DETECT this same shape FAILS CLOSED (UNSUPPORTED_SCP_SHAPE) - it is never misread as an identity policy and run through the escalation engine (which would manufacture critical can-* grants a ceiling can never establish). The auto-detect assertion lives inline in tests/phase13-scp.test.js.
